note: 系列 A 例句軌 C1 slice：自寫，待獨立 reviewer 審。

items.sentence: Had I known the implications, I would never have agreed to the proposal.
items.zh: 早知道會有這些後果，我絕不會同意那項提案。

items.sentence: It was only later that she grasped the full extent of his deception.
items.zh: 直到後來，她才明白他欺騙的全貌。

items.sentence: The committee remains reluctant to commit to any firm deadline.
items.zh: 委員會仍不願承諾任何明確的期限。

items.sentence: His argument, however compelling, ultimately rested on a flawed assumption.
items.zh: 他的論點無論多麼有說服力，終究建立在一個有瑕疵的假設上。

items.sentence: Rarely have I encountered such a thoughtful and articulate speaker.
items.zh: 我很少遇到如此有見地又善於表達的講者。

items.sentence: The findings suggest that creativity thrives under modest constraints rather than total freedom.
items.zh: 研究結果顯示，創造力在適度的約束下反而比完全自由更能蓬勃發展。

items.sentence: She has an uncanny ability to anticipate what others are thinking.
items.zh: 她有一種不可思議的能力，能預料別人在想什麼。

items.sentence: Far from discouraging him, the criticism only strengthened his resolve.
items.zh: 那些批評非但沒有使他氣餒，反而堅定了他的決心。

items.sentence: What strikes me most is how gracefully she handled the setback.
items.zh: 最讓我印象深刻的，是她面對挫折時的從容。

items.sentence: The policy, though well-intentioned, had unintended consequences for small businesses.
items.zh: 這項政策雖然立意良善，卻為小型企業帶來意料之外的後果。

items.sentence: Only by confronting our assumptions can we hope to grow.
items.zh: 唯有正視我們的假設，我們才可能成長。

items.sentence: The novel explores the tension between ambition and personal integrity.
items.zh: 這部小說探討了野心與個人正直之間的張力。

items.sentence: He tends to overstate his case whenever he feels threatened.
items.zh: 他每當感到受威脅時，往往會誇大自己的立場。

items.sentence: Little did they realize how profoundly the decision would shape their future.
items.zh: 他們當時幾乎沒有意識到，這個決定將如何深刻地形塑他們的未來。

items.sentence: A certain humility underlies all genuine scientific inquiry.
items.zh: 一切真正的科學探究背後，都存在著某種謙遜。

items.sentence: The negotiations collapsed, largely because neither side was willing to compromise.
items.zh: 談判破裂了，主要是因為雙方都不願意妥協。

items.sentence: Her resignation came as no surprise to those who knew her well.
items.zh: 對於熟識她的人來說，她的辭職一點也不令人意外。

items.sentence: Technology, for all its benefits, can erode our capacity for patience.
items.zh: 科技儘管好處眾多，卻可能侵蝕我們保持耐心的能力。

items.sentence: Seldom does a single study overturn decades of established thinking.
items.zh: 單一一項研究很少能推翻數十年來既有的看法。

items.sentence: The essay makes a compelling case for rethinking how we measure success.
items.zh: 這篇文章有力地論證了我們應該重新思考如何衡量成功。

items.sentence: Whatever the outcome, I am grateful for the opportunity to contribute.
items.zh: 無論結果如何，我都很感激能有機會貢獻一份心力。

items.sentence: His calm demeanor belied the anxiety he must have felt.
items.zh: 他平靜的神態掩飾了他當時必定感受到的焦慮。

items.sentence: The report highlights the subtle ways bias creeps into our judgments.
items.zh: 這份報告凸顯了偏見悄悄滲入我們判斷的那些細微方式。

items.sentence: Not until the deadline loomed did they begin to take it seriously.
items.zh: 直到期限逼近，他們才開始認真看待這件事。

items.sentence: There is something deeply reassuring about a promise that is kept.
items.zh: 一個被信守的承諾，有某種令人深感安心之處。

items.sentence: The lecture challenged us to question what we take for granted.
items.zh: 這場演講挑戰我們去質疑那些我們視為理所當然的事。

items.sentence: Such was his dedication that he rarely took a day off.
items.zh: 他的投入之深，使他鮮少休假。

items.sentence: Public trust, once lost, is remarkably difficult to restore.
items.zh: 公眾的信任一旦失去，就極難重新建立。

items.sentence: The study underscores the importance of sleep for emotional resilience.
items.zh: 這項研究凸顯了睡眠對情緒韌性的重要性。

items.sentence: However hard we try, some misunderstandings seem impossible to avoid.
items.zh: 無論我們多麼努力，有些誤會似乎終究難以避免。

items.sentence: No sooner had the meeting begun than the power went out.
items.zh: 會議才剛開始，電就停了。

items.sentence: It is her persistence, not her talent, that sets her apart.
items.zh: 讓她與眾不同的是她的堅持，而非她的天賦。

items.sentence: Under no circumstances should the findings be disclosed before publication.
items.zh: 在任何情況下，這些研究結果都不應在發表前被洩露。

items.sentence: The proposal was, on the whole, received more warmly than expected.
items.zh: 整體而言，這份提案獲得的反應比預期更為熱烈。

items.sentence: What matters is not how often you fail, but how you recover.
items.zh: 重要的不是你失敗多少次，而是你如何重新振作。

items.sentence: The minister stopped short of admitting that the policy had failed.
items.zh: 部長並未明說，但幾乎等於承認那項政策已經失敗。

items.sentence: Hardly had we settled in when the neighbors began to complain.
items.zh: 我們才剛安頓下來，鄰居就開始抱怨。

items.sentence: Her latest book is, by any measure, a remarkable achievement.
items.zh: 無論從哪個標準來看，她的新書都是一項了不起的成就。

items.sentence: The reforms, if anything, widened the gap they were meant to close.
items.zh: 這些改革若說有什麼影響，反倒拉大了它們本該縮小的差距。

items.sentence: So convincing was his explanation that no one thought to question it.
items.zh: 他的解釋如此令人信服，以致沒有人想到要質疑。

items.sentence: We would do well to remember how fragile such alliances can be.
items.zh: 我們最好記住，這類聯盟可能有多麼脆弱。

items.sentence: The temptation to oversimplify a complex issue is always there.
items.zh: 把複雜議題過度簡化的誘惑始終存在。

items.sentence: On reflection, I suspect we underestimated just how long it would take.
items.zh: 回想起來，我懷疑我們低估了這會花多少時間。

items.sentence: The evidence, though circumstantial, points firmly in one direction.
items.zh: 這些證據雖屬間接，卻明確指向同一個方向。

items.sentence: Never before had the city faced a crisis of such magnitude.
items.zh: 這座城市此前從未面臨如此規模的危機。

items.sentence: His reluctance to delegate often slows the entire team down.
items.zh: 他不願授權，往往拖慢了整個團隊的進度。

items.sentence: It would be naive to assume that goodwill alone can solve this.
items.zh: 若以為光靠善意就能解決這件事，未免太天真。

items.sentence: The author deliberately leaves the ending open to interpretation.
items.zh: 作者刻意讓結局保有詮釋的空間。

items.sentence: Few would dispute that the reform was long overdue.
items.zh: 幾乎沒有人會否認這項改革早該推行。

items.sentence: Much as I admire her work, I cannot endorse this decision.
items.zh: 儘管我很欣賞她的作品，我仍無法認同這個決定。

items.sentence: The data lends weight to a theory long dismissed as implausible.
items.zh: 這些數據為一個長久以來被視為不可信的理論增添了分量。

items.sentence: There is no denying that the project has exceeded all expectations.
items.zh: 不可否認，這個專案已超越了所有人的預期。

items.sentence: He has a habit of reading far too much into casual remarks.
items.zh: 他有個習慣，總把隨口說的話解讀得過於深刻。

items.sentence: The sheer scale of the undertaking left the volunteers daunted.
items.zh: 這項工程的龐大規模讓志工們望而生畏。

items.sentence: Were it not for her intervention, the deal would have fallen through.
items.zh: 要不是她出面介入，這筆交易早就告吹了。

items.sentence: The report draws a careful distinction between correlation and cause.
items.zh: 這份報告謹慎地區分了相關性與因果關係。

items.sentence: Suffice it to say, the experiment did not go as planned.
items.zh: 總之一句話，那場實驗並未照計畫進行。

items.sentence: She approached the problem with a rigor few could match.
items.zh: 她以一種少有人能及的嚴謹態度處理這個問題。

items.sentence: The more we learn about the brain, the more questions arise.
items.zh: 我們對大腦了解得愈多，浮現的問題就愈多。

items.sentence: His remarks, taken out of context, caused quite a stir.
items.zh: 他的言論被斷章取義後，引起了相當大的騷動。

items.sentence: Granted, the plan has its flaws, but the alternative is worse.
items.zh: 誠然，這個計畫有其缺陷，但替代方案更糟。

items.sentence: The company prides itself on never cutting corners on safety.
items.zh: 這家公司以在安全上從不便宜行事為傲。

items.sentence: What began as a minor dispute soon escalated into a lawsuit.
items.zh: 原本只是小爭執，很快就升級成一場訴訟。

items.sentence: In hindsight, the warning signs had been there all along.
items.zh: 事後看來，那些警訊其實一直都在。

items.sentence: The treaty, for all its shortcomings, averted an outright war.
items.zh: 這項條約儘管有諸多不足，卻避免了一場全面戰爭。

items.sentence: She is not one to shy away from an uncomfortable truth.
items.zh: 她不是那種會逃避難堪真相的人。

items.sentence: The tone of the letter struck me as oddly dismissive.
items.zh: 那封信的語氣讓我覺得出奇地不屑一顧。

items.sentence: Only in retrospect does the pattern become truly apparent.
items.zh: 唯有事後回顧，那個模式才真正變得明顯。

items.sentence: The debate hinges on how we define fairness in the first place.
items.zh: 這場辯論的關鍵，在於我們一開始如何定義公平。

items.sentence: He conceded the point gracefully, without a trace of resentment.
items.zh: 他大方地讓步，毫無一絲怨懟。

items.sentence: Any attempt to rush the process would prove counterproductive.
items.zh: 任何想要加快這個過程的企圖都將適得其反。

items.sentence: The film resonates precisely because it refuses easy answers.
items.zh: 這部電影之所以引起共鳴，正是因為它拒絕提供簡單的答案。

items.sentence: Little by little, her confidence in the team was restored.
items.zh: 一點一滴地，她對團隊的信心重新建立了起來。

items.sentence: The verdict sent ripples through the entire legal community.
items.zh: 這項判決在整個法律界引起了震盪。

items.sentence: We can ill afford to ignore warnings of this kind.
items.zh: 我們實在承擔不起忽視這類警告的後果。

items.sentence: His theory, elegant as it is, remains largely untested.
items.zh: 他的理論儘管優雅，卻大致上仍未經檢驗。

items.sentence: The negotiations hinged on a single, stubbornly contested clause.
items.zh: 談判的成敗繫於一個爭執不下的條款。

items.sentence: Far too often, convenience is mistaken for genuine progress.
items.zh: 人們太常把便利誤認為真正的進步。

items.sentence: She weighed her words with the caution of a seasoned diplomat.
items.zh: 她字斟句酌，謹慎得像個經驗老到的外交官。

items.sentence: The exhibition invites us to see the familiar in a new light.
items.zh: 這場展覽邀請我們以全新的眼光看待熟悉的事物。

items.sentence: The scandal, far from fading, has only gathered momentum in recent weeks.
items.zh: 這樁醜聞非但沒有平息，近幾週反而愈演愈烈。

items.sentence: It is precisely this ambiguity that makes the poem so enduring.
items.zh: 正是這種模糊性，使這首詩如此歷久不衰。

items.sentence: Nowhere is this contradiction more evident than in his own writings.
items.zh: 這個矛盾在他自己的著作中表現得最為明顯。

items.sentence: The reforms were implemented with scant regard for their human cost.
items.zh: 這些改革的推行，幾乎未顧及其對人的衝擊。

items.sentence: She has a knack for turning a dull meeting into a lively exchange.
items.zh: 她很有本事，能把沉悶的會議變成熱絡的交流。

items.sentence: Only after the dust had settled did the real cost become clear.
items.zh: 直到塵埃落定，真正的代價才顯現出來。

items.sentence: The theory, compelling though it sounds, crumbles under close scrutiny.
items.zh: 這個理論聽來雖有說服力，但一經細究便站不住腳。

items.sentence: What the report conspicuously omits is any mention of accountability.
items.zh: 這份報告明顯略過的，是任何關於問責的著墨。

items.sentence: His reputation for candor earned him both admirers and enemies.
items.zh: 他直言不諱的名聲，為他招來了仰慕者，也招來了敵人。

items.sentence: Rarely does a debut novel display such assured command of tone.
items.zh: 一本處女作鮮少能展現如此沉穩的語調掌控。

items.sentence: The committee dithered for months before reaching any firm conclusion.
items.zh: 委員會猶豫了好幾個月，才得出明確的結論。

items.sentence: Not for a moment did she doubt the wisdom of her choice.
items.zh: 她從未有過片刻懷疑自己選擇的明智。

items.sentence: The initiative foundered on a lack of sustained political will.
items.zh: 這項倡議因缺乏持續的政治意志而告失敗。

items.sentence: A healthy skepticism is the hallmark of any serious researcher.
items.zh: 健康的懷疑精神是任何嚴謹研究者的標誌。

items.sentence: Their silence on the matter spoke volumes about their priorities.
items.zh: 他們對此事的沉默，充分道出了他們真正看重什麼。

items.sentence: The documentary lays bare the compromises behind every political triumph.
items.zh: 這部紀錄片揭露了每一場政治勝利背後的妥協。

items.sentence: Impressive as the figures are, they tell only half the story.
items.zh: 這些數字固然亮眼，卻只道出了一半的真相。

items.sentence: He is inclined to mistake stubbornness for strength of character.
items.zh: 他往往把固執誤認為人格的堅定。

items.sentence: The ruling set a precedent that courts would cite for decades.
items.zh: 這項裁決樹立了一個先例，往後數十年法院都會援引。

items.sentence: Seldom has a single speech so decisively shifted public opinion.
items.zh: 一場演講鮮少能如此果斷地扭轉輿論。

items.sentence: The author resists the urge to tie every loose end neatly.
items.zh: 作者克制住把每個懸而未決的情節都收得乾淨俐落的衝動。

items.sentence: It struck me as curious that no one had raised the objection sooner.
items.zh: 讓我覺得奇怪的是，竟沒有人更早提出這個反對意見。

items.sentence: Her argument gained traction once the data were made public.
items.zh: 她的論點在數據公開後開始獲得認同。

items.sentence: No amount of rehearsal could have prepared him for that question.
items.zh: 再多的排練也無法讓他為那個問題做好準備。

items.sentence: The proposal, ambitious to a fault, overlooked some basic constraints.
items.zh: 這份提案雄心過度，忽略了一些基本的限制。

items.sentence: What distinguishes a mentor from a boss is a willingness to listen.
items.zh: 良師與老闆的區別，在於願不願意傾聽。

items.sentence: The firm has long traded on its reputation for discretion.
items.zh: 這家公司長久以來一直仰賴其行事審慎的聲譽。

items.sentence: Scarcely had the applause died down when the critics pounced.
items.zh: 掌聲才剛平息，評論家便蜂擁而上。

items.sentence: The policy betrays a fundamental misreading of how markets behave.
items.zh: 這項政策暴露出對市場運作方式的根本性誤解。

items.sentence: She carries her learning lightly, never once talking down to anyone.
items.zh: 她學識深厚卻不著痕跡，從不曾對任何人擺出高人一等的姿態。

items.sentence: The deeper you dig, the murkier the whole affair becomes.
items.zh: 你愈往下挖，整件事就愈顯得撲朔迷離。

items.sentence: Nothing in his manner suggested the turmoil going on inside.
items.zh: 他的舉止絲毫看不出內心正翻騰著怎樣的動盪。

items.sentence: The verdict hinged less on the facts than on their presentation.
items.zh: 這項判決的關鍵，與其說在於事實，不如說在於陳述的方式。

items.sentence: Any lingering doubts were swept aside by the sheer weight of evidence.
items.zh: 任何殘存的疑慮，都被排山倒海的證據一掃而空。

items.sentence: He wears his achievements lightly, deflecting praise with a shrug.
items.zh: 他對自己的成就看得很淡，總以聳聳肩把讚美推開。

items.sentence: The essay is at its most persuasive when it resists grand claims.
items.zh: 這篇文章在不作誇大斷言時，反而最具說服力。

items.sentence: Little in her upbringing had prepared her for such sudden fame.
items.zh: 她的成長經歷幾乎沒有讓她為這突如其來的名氣做好準備。

items.sentence: The negotiations dragged on, each side loath to blink first.
items.zh: 談判拖延不決，雙方都不願率先讓步。

items.sentence: So entrenched were the old habits that reform seemed almost futile.
items.zh: 舊習積重難返，使得改革幾乎顯得徒勞。

items.sentence: The study casts serious doubt on a long-cherished assumption.
items.zh: 這項研究使一個長久以來深信不疑的假設受到嚴重質疑。

items.sentence: I was taken aback by how readily he abandoned his principles.
items.zh: 他如此輕易地放棄原則，令我大為震驚。

items.sentence: The museum's redesign strikes a fine balance between old and new.
items.zh: 這座博物館的重新設計，在新與舊之間拿捏得恰到好處。

items.sentence: Only time will tell whether the gamble was worth taking.
items.zh: 這場豪賭是否值得，只有時間能證明。

items.sentence: Her prose has a clarity that belies the complexity of her ideas.
items.zh: 她的文筆清晰明快，絲毫看不出其思想的複雜。

items.sentence: The allegations, if substantiated, would end his career overnight.
items.zh: 這些指控若經證實，將讓他的職業生涯一夕終結。

items.sentence: He has a tendency to conflate confidence with competence.
items.zh: 他有把自信混為能力的傾向。

items.sentence: The landscape bears the scars of a century of heavy industry.
items.zh: 這片地景留著一個世紀重工業的傷痕。

items.sentence: Never had the stakes felt quite so high as on that evening.
items.zh: 成敗的分量從未像那個夜晚那樣沉重。

items.sentence: The council's decision flies in the face of expert advice.
items.zh: 議會的決定公然違背了專家的建議。

items.sentence: Whatever his faults, no one could accuse him of complacency.
items.zh: 無論他有什麼缺點，沒有人能指責他自滿。

items.sentence: The reforms amount to little more than tinkering at the margins.
items.zh: 這些改革充其量不過是在枝微末節上修修補補。

items.sentence: Such is the pace of change that yesterday's expertise soon dates.
items.zh: 變化之快，使得昨日的專業知識很快便過時。

items.sentence: She grasped the nuance that had eluded everyone else.
items.zh: 她領會了其他人都沒能察覺的那層微妙之處。

items.sentence: The verdict was met with a mixture of relief and unease.
items.zh: 這項判決引來了鬆一口氣與不安交雜的反應。

items.sentence: His account of events strains credulity at several points.
items.zh: 他對事件的陳述，有好幾處令人難以置信。

items.sentence: At no point did the authorities acknowledge their own role.
items.zh: 當局自始至終都不曾承認自己扮演的角色。

items.sentence: The lecture was a masterclass in how to make complexity accessible.
items.zh: 這場演講堪稱將複雜化為淺顯的典範。

items.sentence: A single misplaced word can unravel years of careful diplomacy.
items.zh: 一個用錯的字眼，就可能瓦解多年苦心經營的外交。

items.sentence: The more entrenched a belief, the harder it is to dislodge.
items.zh: 一種信念愈是根深蒂固，就愈難以撼動。

items.sentence: Her composure under pressure was nothing short of remarkable.
items.zh: 她在壓力下的沉著，簡直令人嘆為觀止。

items.sentence: The proposal was shelved, ostensibly for budgetary reasons.
items.zh: 這份提案被擱置了，表面上是基於預算考量。

items.sentence: He is too shrewd to commit himself before the terms are clear.
items.zh: 他太精明了，在條件明朗之前絕不會表態。

items.sentence: The painting rewards patience, revealing its secrets only gradually.
items.zh: 這幅畫值得細細品味，它的奧祕只會慢慢顯露。

items.sentence: What began as idle curiosity grew into a lifelong obsession.
items.zh: 起初只是隨興的好奇，後來卻成了畢生的痴迷。

items.sentence: The data defies any simple or reassuring interpretation.
items.zh: 這些數據無法用任何簡單或令人安心的方式來解讀。

items.sentence: She tempers her ambition with a rare sense of proportion.
items.zh: 她以難得的分寸感，為自己的野心踩住了煞車。

items.sentence: Rarely is a compromise reached without someone feeling shortchanged.
items.zh: 談成一項妥協，很少不會有人覺得吃了虧。

items.sentence: The memoir is remarkable for its refusal to flatter its author.
items.zh: 這本回憶錄難能可貴之處，在於它不替作者臉上貼金。

items.sentence: His silence could be read as either modesty or indifference.
items.zh: 他的沉默，可以解讀為謙遜，也可以解讀為漠不關心。

items.sentence: The reforms stalled the moment they encountered vested interests.
items.zh: 這些改革一碰上既得利益，便立刻停滯不前。

items.sentence: She has an eye for the detail that others routinely overlook.
items.zh: 她對別人習慣性忽略的細節，有著敏銳的觀察力。

items.sentence: The argument, for all its sophistication, misses the obvious point.
items.zh: 這番論述儘管精巧，卻漏掉了最顯而易見的一點。

items.sentence: Not once did he raise his voice throughout the heated exchange.
items.zh: 在那場激烈的交鋒中，他一次也沒有提高嗓門。

items.sentence: The findings have profound implications for how we teach reading.
items.zh: 這些發現對我們該如何教閱讀，有著深遠的意涵。

items.sentence: Convenience has a way of quietly eroding our better judgment.
items.zh: 便利往往會悄悄侵蝕我們較為明智的判斷。

items.sentence: The witness proved evasive whenever the questions grew specific.
items.zh: 每當問題變得具體，這名證人便顯得閃爍其詞。

items.sentence: Her career is a testament to the value of quiet persistence.
items.zh: 她的事業印證了默默堅持的價值。

items.sentence: The deal unraveled over a technicality neither side had foreseen.
items.zh: 這筆交易因一個雙方都未料到的技術細節而告吹。

items.sentence: So measured was his response that it defused the tension entirely.
items.zh: 他的回應如此有分寸，徹底化解了當下的緊張。

items.sentence: The policy rests on the dubious premise that growth is limitless.
items.zh: 這項政策建立在成長無上限這一可疑的前提上。

items.sentence: She has never been afraid to swim against the tide.
items.zh: 她從不畏懼逆勢而行。

items.sentence: The report stops short of apportioning blame to any one party.
items.zh: 這份報告並未明確將責任歸咎於任何一方。

items.sentence: What unsettles me is not the risk itself but our complacency.
items.zh: 令我不安的不是風險本身，而是我們的自滿。

items.sentence: The scheme collapsed under the weight of its own contradictions.
items.zh: 這個方案在自身矛盾的重壓下崩解了。

items.sentence: He concedes, somewhat grudgingly, that the critics had a point.
items.zh: 他有些不情願地承認，評論者說得有道理。

items.sentence: The city has reinvented itself more than once over the centuries.
items.zh: 這座城市在數百年間不止一次地重塑了自己。

items.sentence: Only a fool would stake his reputation on so fragile a claim.
items.zh: 只有傻瓜才會把自己的聲譽押在如此脆弱的主張上。

items.sentence: The interview revealed a thinker far more subtle than his reputation.
items.zh: 這場訪談呈現出一位遠比其名聲更為細膩的思想家。

items.sentence: Her instinct for the telling detail makes her reporting unforgettable.
items.zh: 她捕捉關鍵細節的本能，使她的報導令人難忘。

items.sentence: The reforms were sold as modernization but amounted to retreat.
items.zh: 這些改革被包裝成現代化，實則是一種倒退。

items.sentence: Seldom have I seen a team recover so swiftly from such a blow.
items.zh: 我很少見過一支團隊能從這樣的打擊中如此迅速地恢復。

items.sentence: The proposal sidesteps the thorniest question of funding altogether.
items.zh: 這份提案根本就迴避了經費這個最棘手的問題。

items.sentence: His optimism, though admirable, bordered on willful blindness.
items.zh: 他的樂觀雖然可敬，卻近乎一廂情願的視而不見。

items.sentence: The study's conclusions should be treated with appropriate caution.
items.zh: 這項研究的結論應以適度的謹慎看待。

items.sentence: She carved out a niche where others saw only an empty field.
items.zh: 別人只看到一片空白，她卻在其中開闢出一方天地。

items.sentence: The debate generated more heat than light, as such debates often do.
items.zh: 這場辯論一如這類辯論常見的那樣，只見火氣不見道理。

items.sentence: Not even his harshest critics questioned his sincerity.
items.zh: 連他最嚴厲的批評者也不曾質疑他的真誠。

items.sentence: The institution thrives on a culture of candid disagreement.
items.zh: 這個機構靠著坦率爭辯的文化而蓬勃發展。

items.sentence: A good question, well posed, is often worth more than an answer.
items.zh: 一個提得好的問題，往往比一個答案更有價值。

items.sentence: The committee's indecision has become a liability in its own right.
items.zh: 委員會的優柔寡斷，本身已成了一項負擔。
